company.name: Udrive
company.shortDescription: Udrive is a car-sharing platform enabling users to rent vehicles instantly via mobile app for flexible, short-term use.
company.description: Udrive is the first pay-per-minute car sharing provider in the Middle East which offers car rental through mobile access on the street. Udrive is a Dubai-based mobility platform offering on-demand car sharing and rental services through a smartphone app. Founded in 2016, it enables users to rent vehicles by the minute, hour, day, or month across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Udrive focuses on convenient urban mobility, integrating digital payments, flexible rentals, fuel, parking, and insurance into a seamless app-based transportation experience.
